verdict.rationale: The only automation evidence is Plausible's built-in traffic spike/drop notifications, which alert users by email or Slack when traffic spikes. That is a narrow, fixed-type trigger rather than a general user-defined rules engine. Scheduled email and Slack reports are time-based, not event-triggered, so they do not count. Missing for 10: user-definable rule conditions (e.g., on goals or custom events), configurable actions beyond notifications, outbound webhooks or programmatic triggers, and documentation depth on how alert thresholds are configured.
